01 — Cybersecurity

Spot risks before they cause damage.

Attacks on small and mid-sized companies keep rising, mostly through known, avoidable weaknesses. We make your risks visible and close gaps systematically.

What you get

  • Management summary with risk rating
  • Detailed technical report with evidence
  • Prioritised action plan
  • Retest after remediation

Standards & frameworks

  • BSI IT-Grundschutz
  • ISO/IEC 27001
  • NIS2
  • OWASP
  • CIS Controls

Security audits

Structured review of infrastructure, configuration and processes based on BSI IT-Grundschutz and CIS Benchmarks.

Penetration testing

Authorised attack simulations against web applications, external infrastructure and internal networks, with a traceable report.

Vulnerability management

Continuous scanning, risk-based prioritisation and guided remediation instead of endless reports.

NIS2 & ISO 27001 readiness

Gap analysis, policies, risk management and evidence, so you pass audits and customer requirements with confidence.

Email & identity security

SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MFA, conditional access and least privilege: the most effective protections first.

Awareness & incident response

Practical training for your team, plus emergency plans and hands-on support when it counts.
